suite.name: Codex Efficiency Suite
suite.purpose: Reusable deterministic tools that reduce repeated agent work and improve verification.

adoption_policy.source_of_truth: This manifest defines the tools Codex should consider for project work.
adoption_policy.default_behavior: Use every applicable tool marked stable unless the project or task explicitly excludes it.
adoption_policy.experimental_behavior: Do not use experimental tools unless explicitly requested or the task is tool development.
adoption_policy.project_configuration: Keep project-specific configuration local to each project and preserve existing conventions.
adoption_policy.update_rule: Every new tool must be registered here before it is considered stable and broadly adoptable.

tools.name: Reproduction and Verification Runner
tools.purpose: Run an explicit verification command, preserve complete diagnostics, classify the result, and reject stale or changed-source evidence.
project_integration: Use the project's existing deterministic test or verification command.
Run after implementation changes and again before declaring completion.
tools.acceptance: Only PASS is successful. FAIL, TIMEOUT, and ERROR require investigation or explicit reporting.
